note: media_gallery_migration2 is a submodule of media_gallery that imports Drupal 7 Media 7.x-2.x galleries (the counterpart of media_gallery_migration for Media 7.x-1.x). It ships three migrate_plus.migration config entities (group media_gallery, all enforced by media_gallery_migration2): d7_media_gallery_files (source d7_media_gallery_file -> entity:file), d7_media_gallery_media (source d7_media_gallery_file -> entity:media bundle image), d7_media_gallery_entity (source d7_node node_type media_gallery -> entity:media_gallery; images sub_process reads source 'media_gallery_file'). Its source plugin d7_media_gallery_file (MediaGalleryFile extends DrupalSqlBase) reads file_managed and in prepareRow filters to gallery files via the D7 table field_data_media_gallery_file (column media_gallery_file_fid) -- that table/column plus the 'media_gallery_file' images source are the only meaningful differences from media_gallery_migration (which uses field_data_media_gallery_media / media_gallery_media). Depends on media_gallery, migrate, migrate_drupal, migrate_plus, migrate_tools. No permissions, no config schema, no own Drush commands. source.constants.source_base_path defaults to the placeholder http://d7media.docksal.site. Shares migration ids with media_gallery_migration, so only one can be enabled at once. Medium cases enable the submodule and read live migration config; hard cases start from it uninstalled and require enabling it so the migration config becomes registered, verified against config.

evals.prompt: There are two migration submodules for media_gallery. Which Drupal 7 Media version does media_gallery_migration2 target, and what migration ids does it define?
evals.expected_output: media_gallery_migration2 targets Media 7.x-2.x. It defines three migrate_plus migrations in group media_gallery: d7_media_gallery_files (-> file), d7_media_gallery_media (-> media, bundle image), and d7_media_gallery_entity (D7 media_gallery nodes -> media_gallery entities). media_gallery_migration is the 7.x-1.x variant.

evals.prompt: In media_gallery_migration2, the d7_media_gallery_file source plugin decides which files belong to a gallery. Which Drupal 7 table (and column) does it join in prepareRow(), and how does that differ from the other migration submodule?
evals.expected_output: It joins field_data_media_gallery_file (column media_gallery_file_fid) and skips files not in a gallery. The 7.x-1.x submodule (media_gallery_migration) instead joins field_data_media_gallery_media / media_gallery_media_fid. Correspondingly, media_gallery_migration2's d7_media_gallery_entity reads the images sub_process from source 'media_gallery_file'.

evals.prompt: Can media_gallery_migration and media_gallery_migration2 both be enabled on the same Drupal site at once? Why or why not, and what must you set before running either?
evals.expected_output: No. Both submodules ship migrate_plus migration config entities with the same ids (d7_media_gallery_entity/_files/_media), so only one can be enabled at a time -- choose the one matching your D7 Media version. Before running either, set source.constants.source_base_path (default placeholder http://d7media.docksal.site) and register the legacy D7 database as the migrate source connection.

evals.prompt: On this site the media_gallery_migration2 submodule is enabled. Inspect the live migrate_plus.migration.d7_media_gallery_entity configuration and report which source property the 'images' field is built from (the sub_process source).
evals.expected_output: In d7_media_gallery_entity, process.images is a sub_process whose source is 'media_gallery_file' (with a migration_lookup on d7_media_gallery_media). This is the Media 7.x-2.x property name, discoverable via drush config:get migrate_plus.migration.d7_media_gallery_entity process.images.

evals.prompt: The media_gallery_migration2 submodule is enabled on this site. Inspect the live migrate_plus.migration.d7_media_gallery_files configuration and report the source plugin it uses and the module it is enforced by.
evals.expected_output: d7_media_gallery_files uses source.plugin d7_media_gallery_file and its dependencies.enforced.module is media_gallery_migration2. Discoverable via drush config:get migrate_plus.migration.d7_media_gallery_files.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has the media_gallery module but the Media 7.x-2.x gallery migrations are not currently available. Using the media_gallery_migration2 submodule, make those D7 gallery migrations available on the live site (so the d7_media_gallery_entity migration is registered).
evals.expected_output: Enable the submodule (drush en media_gallery_migration2 -y), which installs its enforced migration config. Afterwards migrate_plus.migration.d7_media_gallery_entity exists with source.plugin d7_node, images sub_process source 'media_gallery_file', and dependencies.enforced.module including media_gallery_migration2.

evals.prompt: On this site, ensure the media_gallery_migration2 submodule's D7 file import migration is registered live: after your change, the d7_media_gallery_files migration (which uses the custom d7_media_gallery_file source plugin) must exist in the site configuration.
evals.expected_output: Enable the submodule (drush en media_gallery_migration2 -y). Then migrate_plus.migration.d7_media_gallery_files exists with source.plugin d7_media_gallery_file and dependencies.enforced.module including media_gallery_migration2.
